gold_review.explanation: Every row's answer is the constant placeholder "Evaluate final transfer trace". The reward recomputes a transfer case from info.seed/family and requires a 7-key JSON object (decision/evidence/trigger/scope/steps/verification/exception) with event IDs taken from the second-turn trace, so no reply built from the answer can score.
